national_news.title: Ladakh Becomes First Union Territory to Begin Digital Self-Enumeration for Census 2027
bullets: Ladakh initiated the self-enumeration phase (August 17–31) for Census 2027, becoming the first UT to launch the population enumeration exercise.
The population enumeration phase is scheduled from September 1 to 30 with October 1, 2027, as the reference date, adjusted for harsh winter conditions and terrain.
The census is conducted completely digitally across 637 created Enumeration Blocks (EBs), following 100% digital house listing completed earlier.
